sections.heading: Execution checklist
sections.body:
1. Confirm live supply APR for USDT on your chosen lender
2. Size 75% of $5,000 into lending first (safest leg)
3. If farm sleeve: prefer PCS pools with deep liquidity; set IL mental stop
4. Keep gas budget ≤ $4.00; batch approvals
5. Screenshot starting balances for later PnL

sections.heading: PancakeSwap note
sections.body: When PCS farm clears risk-adjusted hurdles vs pure lending, use it as the satellite sleeve — not the core. IL can erase APR quickly on volatile pairs.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body:
• Smart contract: Prefer audited, high-TVL venues
• IL: Farms with non-stable pairs
• Liquidity: Exit path must work under stress
• Custody: Agent never moves funds — you execute
